description: Source code for handling Avro serialization and reporting of neighboring access points in a harvester system, including schema parsing, buffer management, and webpa message sending.

methods.name: prepare_nap_writer
methods.description: Prepares an Avro writer with schema loaded from file and initializes buffer with headers.

methods.name: harvester_report_neighboringap
methods.description: Serializes neighboring access point data into Avro format, encodes in base64, and sends via WebPA.

methods.name: ap_avro_cleanup
methods.description: Frees allocated schema buffer and decrements Avro interface reference.

methods.name: GetNAPSchemaBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to the schema buffer.

methods.name: GetNAPSchemaBufferSize
methods.description: Returns size of the schema buffer.

methods.name: GetNAPSchemaIDBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to the schema ID buffer.

methods.name: GetNAPSchemaIDBufferSize
methods.description: Returns size of the schema ID buffer.

methods.name: GetNeighborAPAvroBuf
methods.description: Returns pointer to the serialized Avro buffer.

methods.name: GetNeighborAPAvroBufSize
methods.description: Returns size of the serialized Avro buffer.
